description: A pasted line 'Verification code: 9fb7 99bc 8b49 1723' (copied from the terminal) is rejected with the generic four-groups message. The page could strip a leading label, or name the problem.
expected: Accept the pasted line or say 'remove the label'.
actual: Enter the verification code your agent printed, as four groups like a1b2 c3d4 e5f6 7890.
suggested_fix: Strip non-hex prefix or mention 'digits 0-9 and letters a-f only'.

description: A character outside 0-9a-f (letter l for 1, o for 0) gives the same format message; it does not say hex digits only, so a user who typed what they read tries again with the same letter.
The format error wraps leaving the orphan '7890.' on its own line, and sits against the focus ring.
actual: Two-line message with a one-word second line.
suggested_fix: Shorten to 'Enter the 16-character verification code from your terminal.'
